paragraphs: Granicus makes software that governments use to reach residents, understand them, and serve them online. A second line serves destination marketing organizations, with tools meant to attract visitors and win events.

The catalog covers agenda and meeting management, digital services and forms, communications and engagement, permitting and licensing, and public records compliance. Video streaming and hosting sits alongside those products. The company has since added Government Experience Agent, which it calls the first AI-powered digital agent built specifically for government requirements, giving residents support around the clock.

Granicus states that it has more than 2,000 employees supporting more than 7,000 public sector organizations. Customer stories name the Oklahoma Health Care Authority among the agencies using Granicus. Its own history page traces the business to a merger with GovDelivery, after which the combined company took the Granicus name. It later acquired destination marketing services provider Simpleview.
